decisions.reason: A startup accelerator program sits outside the firm's machinery and recycling engineering knowledge base. The firm has little related knowledge for interpreting its results or improving it, so as the core business grows its resources are likely to be pulled back.

The bio-based bitumen binder is a flagship that draws on the firm's own R&D in materials conversion, but it is a materials product far from its plant-building core. The risk of dropping it is moderate, though its strategic emphasis justifies keeping it for now.

The infectious waste decontamination plant builds directly on the firm's modular WASTX plant expertise and is co-developed with ERMAFA. This gives the firm strong absorptive capacity to learn from early results and refine the product.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is a close extension of the firm's core decentralized recycling machinery. It can serve as a pretreatment stage for existing systems, so the firm can readily assimilate customer feedback and improve it.
